comment: Fold cases (wave 028, runs 0207 and 0208, issue #65, decisions DEC-6 and DEC-8). Java reads this file: PlateauFoldServiceTest runs each case through the service and PlateauFoldCommandTest through `archicode plateau fold`; FoldTest builds its own data; the node test of run 0208 (fold-workspace.test.js) opens the folded workspaces of the small write cases in the editor. A case copies the folder `base` of src/test/resources first (null: an empty folder), then writes `files` over the copy (a path from the workspace folder, the whole text of the file); `args` are the arguments after `plateau fold` (the service reads the plateau id, args[0]; a case folds, and writes, unless `--dry-run` is among the args); a case with `scope: command` is run through the command only. `expect` is an `error` (the line the command prints on the error output, with `error: ` in front; exit 1, nothing on the standard output) or the `output` lines of the report (exit 0; an empty string is a blank line), and may carry `files` for a case that writes: a path from the workspace folder to the exact new text, to null for a deleted file, or to the marker "changed" for a file that must differ from the base without its text being pinned; every file not named is checked byte for byte unchanged, and no file is added. A refusal and a dry run leave the whole folder as it was. The cases F09 to F12 of the TDD of run 0207 (an entry that names an element of the plateau below, a plateau no manifest declares, a patch that sets replaces, a fold into a plateau whose parent is the root) are hand-made data of FoldTest.

files..archicode.yaml:
settings:
  name: "Brightcart"
  current: "inhouse"
  views:
    path: "views"
  facets:
    customs:
      - name: "journey"            # the purchase journey: no staff tools, no fulfilment
        actions:
          - operator: REMOVE
            json-path: "$.application..elements[?(@.id == 'agent' || @.id == 'merchandiser' || @.id == 'backoffice' || @.id == 'fulfilment')]"
      - name: "no-externals"       # what Brightcart builds, without its partners
        actions:
          - operator: REMOVE
            json-path: "$.application..elements[?(@.tags['rendering-stereotypes'] == 'external')]"
      - name: "without-cart"       # selects nothing in `saas`, where the cart is gone
        actions:
          - operator: REMOVE
            json-path: "$.application..elements[?(@.id == 'cart')]"
  manifests:
    paths: ["./**"]
styles:
  by-tags:
    external:
      background-color: "lightgray"
    legacy:
      line-style: 8
      line-gap: 4
    hot-path:
      line-color: "orangered"
      line-thickness: 3
  by-qualifiers:
    PostgreSQL:
      round-corner: 20
